intro.text: A young woman in Straff Venture's company during the Siege of Luthadel.

items.text: Attended Straff's parley with Elend during the Siege of Luthadel, where Straff used her to tell Elend he could have a woman like Vin, only younger and prettier. Straff sent her away soon after Vin told him they didn't have the atium.
After Vin and Elend left, Straff sent for her again to make himself feel in charge.
